info.name: Aiden API
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for testing the Aiden platform. This collection includes endpoints for user authentication, profile management, inventory, auctions, orders, and more. Each folder is organized by app and functionality.

variable.description: Base URL for the API
JWT access token for authenticated requests
JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens
ID of a seller for testing seller-specific endpoints
ID of a buyer for testing buyer-specific endpoints
ID of a product for testing product-specific endpoints
ID of a listing for testing listing-specific endpoints
ID of an auction for testing auction-specific endpoints

item.name: Accounts App
item.description: Endpoints for user authentication, profile management, and admin operations

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user authentication including login, registration, token refresh, and logout

request.description: Register a new user with company information. This endpoint creates a new user account and organization. The role can be 'buyer' or 'seller'.

Login with email and password to get JWT tokens. This endpoint returns an access token and a refresh token. The access token should be included in the Authorization header for authenticated requests. The refresh token can be used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires.
Refresh access token using refresh token. This endpoint is used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires. The refresh token has a longer lifespan than the access token.
Logout and blacklist the refresh token. This endpoint invalidates the refresh token, preventing it from being used to obtain new access tokens. The access token will still be valid until it expires.

item.name: Profile Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing user profiles, including retrieving profile information, changing passwords, and accepting terms of service

request.description: Get user profile information. This endpoint returns detailed information about the authenticated user, including their organization details and role.
Change user password. This endpoint allows users to change their password by providing their current password and a new password.
Accept terms of service. This endpoint allows users to accept the terms of service, which is required for using certain features of the platform.

item.name: Admin Operations
item.description: Endpoints for administrative operations, including managing organizations and creating admin users

request.description: List all organizations (admin only). This endpoint returns a list of all organizations in the system, including their status and role.

response.name: Success

request.description: List organizations pending approval (admin only). This endpoint returns a list of organizations that are pending approval, allowing admins to review and approve them.

variable.description: ID of the organization to approve/reject

request.description: Approve or reject an organization (admin only). This endpoint allows admins to approve or reject organizations that are pending approval. The action can be 'approve' or 'reject'.
Create a new admin user (admin only). This endpoint allows existing admins to create new admin users in the system.

item.name: Inventory App
item.description: Endpoints for managing products, seller profiles, buyer profiles, and warehouse operations

item.name: Products
item.description: Endpoints for managing product information and inventory

query.description: Search products by name or description

request.description: List all products with optional filtering. This endpoint returns a paginated list of products that can be filtered by seller, category, or searched by name/description.

response.name: Success

request.description: Create a new product. This endpoint allows sellers to create new products in their inventory. The product will be associated with the seller's profile automatically.

variable.description: ID of the product to retrieve

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific product. This endpoint returns detailed information about a product, including its specifications and seller information.

response.name: Success
response.body:
{
    "id": 1,
    "name": "MacBook Pro",
    "description": "13-inch MacBook Pro with M1 chip",
    "category": "electronics",
    "brand": "Apple",
    "model": "MBP13-M1",
    "condition": "new",
    "seller": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Aiden Project"
    },
    "created_at": "2023-03-15T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2023-03-15T12:00:00Z"
}

variable.description: ID of the product to update

request.description: Update a product's information. This endpoint allows sellers to update their product information. Only the seller who owns the product can update it.

variable.description: ID of the product to delete

request.description: Delete a product. This endpoint allows sellers to delete their products. Only the seller who owns the product can delete it.

item.name: Seller Profiles
item.description: Endpoints for managing seller profiles and their settings

request.description: Get the current user's seller profile. This endpoint returns detailed information about the seller's profile, including their organization details and settings.
Update the seller's profile settings. This endpoint allows sellers to update their profile information, including warehouse location, payment preferences, and minimum order value.

item.name: Buyer Profiles
item.description: Endpoints for managing buyer profiles and their settings

request.description: Get the current user's buyer profile. This endpoint returns detailed information about the buyer's profile, including their organization details and preferences.
Update the buyer's profile settings. This endpoint allows buyers to update their profile information, including preferred categories and sellers.

item.name: Warehouse Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing warehouse locations and inventory

request.description: List all warehouses for the current seller. This endpoint returns a list of all warehouses associated with the seller's organization.

request.description: Create a new warehouse. This endpoint allows sellers to create new warehouse locations for their inventory.

variable.description: ID of the warehouse to retrieve

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific warehouse. This endpoint returns detailed information about a warehouse, including its capacity and current usage.

variable.description: ID of the warehouse to update

request.description: Update a warehouse's information. This endpoint allows sellers to update their warehouse information, including name, location, and capacity.

variable.description: ID of the warehouse to delete

request.description: Delete a warehouse. This endpoint allows sellers to delete warehouse locations. Only warehouses with no inventory can be deleted.

item.name: Auctions App
item.description: Endpoints for managing auctions, listings, bids, and sale events

query.description: Filter events by status (open, closed, pending)

request.description: List all sale events with optional filtering. This endpoint returns a paginated list of sale events that can be filtered by seller or status.

response.name: Success

request.description: Create a new sale event. This endpoint allows sellers to create new sale events. The event will be created with a 'pending' status.

response.name: Success
response.body:
{
    "id": 3,
    "name": "New Sale Event",
    "description": "Description of the sale event",
    "seller": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Aiden Project"
    },
    "start_date": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z",
    "end_date": "2023-04-08T12:00:00Z",
    "status": "pending",
    "listing_count": 0,
    "total_value": 0
}

variable.description: ID of the sale event to retrieve

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific sale event. This endpoint returns detailed information about a sale event, including its listings and metrics.

response.name: Success

variable.description: ID of the sale event to update

request.description: Update a sale event's information. This endpoint allows sellers to update their sale event information. Only events in 'pending' status can be fully updated.

variable.description: ID of the sale event to start

request.description: Start a sale event. This endpoint changes the event status from 'pending' to 'open' and makes all associated listings available for bidding.

variable.description: ID of the sale event to close

request.description: Close a sale event. This endpoint changes the event status to 'closed' and finalizes all winning bids.

query.description: Filter listings by sale event ID
Filter listings by status (active, pending, sold, expired)

request.description: List all listings with optional filtering. This endpoint returns a paginated list of listings that can be filtered by sale event, status, or seller.

response.name: Success

request.description: Create a new listing. This endpoint allows sellers to create new listings for their products in a sale event.

variable.description: ID of the listing to retrieve

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific listing. This endpoint returns detailed information about a listing, including its bids and metrics.

response.name: Success

variable.description: ID of the listing to update

request.description: Update a listing's information. This endpoint allows sellers to update their listing information. Only listings in 'pending' status can be fully updated.

variable.description: ID of the listing to delete

request.description: Delete a listing. This endpoint allows sellers to delete their listings. Only listings in 'pending' status can be deleted.

item.name: Bids
item.description: Endpoints for managing bids on auction listings

query.description: Filter bids by status (winning, outbid, expired)

request.description: List all bids with optional filtering. This endpoint returns a paginated list of bids that can be filtered by listing, buyer, or status.

response.name: Success

request.description: Create a new bid. This endpoint allows buyers to place bids on active listings.

variable.description: ID of the bid to retrieve

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific bid. This endpoint returns detailed information about a bid, including its status and related listing details.

response.name: Success

variable.description: ID of the bid to cancel

request.description: Cancel a bid. This endpoint allows buyers to cancel their bids. Only bids that are not winning can be cancelled.
